bradykin-induced plasma extravasations in the rat knee are dependent upon the production and release from sympathetic postganglonic neuron (SPGN)-terminal of at least two factors: a prostaglandlandin and an unidentified substance.

the mechanisms involved in the sympathetically dependent BK-induced plasma extravasaion.
the role of SPGN terminals in the production of plasma extravasation and the role of the arachidonic pathway in this process.
the identification of the sympathetic neuron factors involved in the bradykinin induced plasma extravasation.
